newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel enthused by MCI-BT merger.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel enthused by MCI-BT merger.

text.p: Avantel, the Mexico-based telephone company that has MCI International as a partner, said it was encouraged by MCI's merger this week with British Telecommunications.
The new BT-MCI firm, called Concert, will be the third-largest telecommunications company in the world.

"The merger means good news for Avantel and the Mexican telecommunications market because it now has a stronger partner, capable of providing joint services both for local and national and international long-distance calls," Avantel said in a communique.
Avantel is a partnership between MCI and Banamex-Accival, Mexico's largest financial group. Avantel is widely considered one of the strongest new competitors to Telmex, the former monopoly.

"Avantel's plans for Mexico will not be affected by the merger. To the contrary, they will be strengthened thanks to the birth of Concert," Avantel director general Manuel Sanchez Lugo was quoted as saying in the Avantel communique.
